newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Sweden trade Aug surplus seen 5.0 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Sweden trade Aug surplus seen 5.0 bln skr.

text.p: Sweden's balance of trade in August is expected to be 5.0 billion crown surplus, a Reuter poll of 16 analysts showed on Friday.
Forecasts ranged from a surplus of three billion crowns to a surplus of 10.3 billion crowns.
The trade balance in July showed a surplus of 9.7 billion crowns, and the August 1995 surplus was 3.9 billion crowns.
Sweden' official statistics bureau Statistics Sweden is due to publish the figure at 0800 GMT on October 2.
